upstreamAvailability.verified: Source, source URL, source record ID, action taxonomy and amount are present
upstreamAvailability.semanticConstrained: No verified dividend date semantics are present

rules.typeRule: Use upstream action_type only; never infer from amount
rules.frequencyRule: Requires sufficient verified dated history; otherwise DATE_CONSTRAINED or INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY
rules.upcomingRule: Requires a verified future ex, record, or payment date
